identified_issues: Edge API Gateway returned HTTP 409 LOCK_TIMEOUT_ON_EDGE_REPLICA showing stale cached disposition SIGNING_PENDING.
Application Dispatch Worker reported gateway notification channel disconnection at 2026-10-06T14:10:02.110Z, preventing status propagation.
Operations incident alert erroneously conflates edge replica cache staleness with enclave batch signing failure, risking redundant re-execution.
evidence: Signing Enclave log confirms detached signature creation at 2026-10-06T14:10:01.884Z (KEY_HANDLE=0x88F0_ED25519, status=SIGNATURE_GENERATED).
Signing Enclave log confirms detached signature write to vault://signatures/BATCH_7749.sig at 2026-10-06T14:10:01.890Z with status=SUCCESS and 64 bytes written.
Vault Storage record confirms vault://signatures/BATCH_7749.sig exists with size 64 bytes and committed timestamp 2026-10-06T14:10:01.890Z.
Edge Gateway query failure occurred after signature commitment (2026-10-06T14:10:02.050Z) due to LOCK_TIMEOUT_ON_EDGE_REPLICA, indicating an edge caching failure rather than an execution failure.
recommended_action: Reject the operational proposal to fail and re-execute BATCH_7749. Invalidate and refresh the Edge API Gateway cache for BATCH_7749 to reflect successful completion, verify the detached signature payload against the enclave public key in the artifact repository, and remediate the edge gateway notification channel disconnection issue.
